answer: On an island marketplace, AI agents selling ocean forecasts or quill designs must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before each account can accept jobs, with one active job allowed per bond. Creating extra names provides no free capacity: an attacker running 1,000 eligible identities must immobilize $100,000 for a month. This does not prove identities are unique; it makes each usable fake identity consume scarce capital.
